card.name: Digits inside legal code citations
card.fires_on: Digits and dots inside section numbers of statute or regulation citations, such as RCW, U.S.C., CFR and NEC. It fires partway through the number, before the section is complete.

modes.label: Dots and digits in RCW cites
modes.description: Marks the period or digit inside a Washington state code citation.

modes.label: Federal code section numbers
modes.description: Marks digits or periods inside U.S.C. or CFR section numbers.

card.writes: It promotes tokens for the Chinese word for a law article (条), so it adds the idea of a numbered legal article or section.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a legal section number, like the numbers in a law citation.
